notes.title: Warriors United – Update v0.3.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I just pushed a small update to Warriors United with a few fixes and improvements based on your feedback:

[h2]Staggered Enemies Fix[/h2]
I fixed a bug where some enemies would stay flat on the ground indefinitely after being staggered. They should now recover properly and keep the fight going.

[h2]Mouse Input Mode Improvement[/h2]
I’ve enhanced the way mouse input controls the camera to make it feel smoother and more comfortable overall. It should now be a better experience, especially in fast-paced combat.

[h2]Sensitivity & Camera Settings[/h2]
You can now adjust mouse and joystick sensitivity, as well as camera smoothing, right from the settings menu. Hopefully, this helps you fine-tune the feel to your liking.

Thanks for all the support and feedback—I'm always listening and working to improve the game!

notes.title: Warriors United - Update v0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone !

It’s been a while since the last update, and I want to start by thanking you all for your patience. Over the past few months, I had to slow down development to focus on my studies and personal life. Taking that time allowed me to come back with a fresh perspective and renewed motivation !

Today, I’m excited to release a major update for Warriors United, focused on UI improvements and overall gameplay comfort. 

[h2]Here’s what’s new[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Complete UI overhaul[/b] – The entire interface has been redesigned to be cleaner, smoother, and more user-friendly.
[*] [b]New SFX for menu navigation[/b] – Every action now comes with satisfying audio feedback to boost immersion.
[*] [b]More customization options[/b] – Tune the game experience more precisely to your liking.
[*] [b]Improved in-game UI comfort[/b] – Better readability, cleaner layout, and quicker access to essential info.
[*] [b]Revamped mini-map[/b] – It’s now actually useful, with dynamic icons that adapt to the situation!
[*] [b]Skill visuals reworked[/b] – Skill effects are now clearer and more impactful, making battles more readable and exciting.
[*] [b]Visual and audio upgrades for resource gathering[/b] – Picking up items and healing now feels way more satisfying!
[/list]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

I’m currently working on improving combat attacks and adding gameplay customization options, so you’ll soon be able to fine-tune your fighting style to match your preferences. Progress is going well, and I’ll share more news on that soon!

Thank you again for all your support during this time — this is just the beginning of what’s planned for Warriors United !

See you in-game!

notes.title: Warriors United - December 2024
notes.content:
Hey warriors !

As we gear up for the end of 2024, I’m happy to share some exciting plans for Warriors United. Here’s what you can look forward to in December and beyond!

[h1]UI Overhaul for a Better Experience[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231035/23947104f58ce6daf1cf79bfb1c63eb60c95e20f.png[/img]
I’m working on a complete rework of the game’s UI to improve quality of life, clarity, and overall functionality. This update will bring:
[list]
[*] [b]Character Combo Customization[/b]: Tailor your character’s moves to suit your playstyle.
[*] [b]Party Info Display[/b]: Keep track of your team’s key stats in real-time.
[*] [b]Enemy Health Bars[/b]: See how close you are to victory during battles.
[*] [b]Target Mode[/b] : Improvements to the feature for smoother gameplay.
[/list]
These changes are aimed at making the game more intuitive and enjoyable for all players.

[h1]Enhanced Animations and Dynamic Combos[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231035/f333aac4ded530e9ac2d09fc85c99cd02a8e4b6b.png[/img]
To make the gameplay even more engaging, I’ll be reworking and expanding the animations. Expect smoother transitions, more variety in moves, and greater combo diversity. 
Here are some of the animations I’d like to add:
[list]
[*] [b]Jump[/b]: Players will gain the ability to jump and perform combos while in the air.
[*] [b]Ultimate Attack[/b]: I’ll introduce a powerful ultimate attack for players. This move will take time to trigger but will be visually spectacular.
[*] [b]Varied Combos in Target Mode[/b]: Animations in target mode will become more dynamic, focusing specifically on the targeted enemy.
[/list]
These updates are set to make combat feel more dynamic and satisfying.

[h1]The Future: More Content to Come[/h1]
Once these updates are in place, my focus will shift to creating new content, including:
[list]
[*] Additional playable characters.
[*] Fresh maps to explore.
[*] Unique and challenging enemies.
[*] A storyline to immerse you further into the world of Warriors United.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support during Early Access. Your feedback helps shape the game into something truly special. Stay tuned for more updates and let me know your thoughts as these changes roll out!

See you on the battlefield,
Benfau.

notes.title: Warriors United - Update v0.2.4
notes.content:
[b]Hey warriors ! Get ready for an update that will enhance your gameplay experience and bring more stability to Warriors United. [/b]
Here are the following changes :

[b]Animation Stuck Bug Fix[/b] – No more frustration during combat: the bug where the character would get stuck in animations, whether during attacks or after taking damage, has been resolved.

[b]Solo Mode Pause[/b] – A pause feature has been added in solo mode, making your character invincible outside of combat for complete peace of mind.

[b]Life System[/b] – A brand-new life system has been implemented, adding more challenge to every encounter.

[b]Multiplayer Improvements[/b] – I have worked on the stability and reliability of multiplayer mode to ensure a smooth, uninterrupted experience. Enjoy an enhanced level of immersion during your online sessions.

[b]Updated Hitmarkers[/b] – For more intuitive combat, the visual feedback when taking hits has been adjusted to better inform players of the impact of their actions.

[b]Transparent Foliage [/b]– Trees will become transparent when the camera moves through them, allowing you to keep an unobstructed view of the action.

[b]Danger Effects: Flashing Screen and Heartbeat Sound[/b] – Immerse yourself in heightened tension with new visual and auditory indicators signaling low health during combat.

[b]Health Bar Animation[/b] – The health bar now features a dynamic animation when taking damage, providing more appealing visual feedback.

[list]
[*] Partez pour des quêtes épiques en coopération avec vos amis.
[*] Engagez-vous dans des combats intenses contre des ennemis uniques.
[*] Explorez des environnements magnifiquement conçus en low-poly.
